title: IconButtonConfig
description: Serializable configuration for the accessible RibbonUI icon button atom.

label.description: Required accessible name for the icon-only control.

icon.description: Allowlisted built-in icon rendered without arbitrary markup.

variant.description: Semantic visual emphasis of the icon button.

size.description: Explicit control and icon target size.

disabled.description: Whether native activation and focus participation are disabled.
